parole.motivo_incerta: Uncertain; Possibly; or from; modello unc/uncertain
parole.significato: A member of the Wyandot people, a Native American group.
parole.testo: From French Huron; Uncertain; possibly from French hure (“boar’s head”) or from a Wyandot word containing the Iroquoian root ronon (“nation”), from Proto-North Iroquoian *-ɹonõʔ.
